lines.en: Porcelain feet, light steps.

lines.zh: 瓶口的枝条摇着，像招手。
lines.en: Branches in my mouth sway, beckoning.
I shift slowly. The porcelain stays level.
One step, one pause. I fear cracking.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，留下盐痕。
lines.en: Salt marks follow my steps.

lines.zh: 体内有什么在晃，响得很闷。
lines.en: Something sloshes inside. A dull sound.

lines.zh: 我的瓶身比人还高一些。
lines.en: My vase body stands taller than a man.
I turn slowly in the doorway.

lines.zh: 枝条先探出去，身体才跟上。
lines.en: The branches reach out first. The body follows.

lines.zh: 我移动的方式，像被搬动。
lines.en: I move as if being carried.

lines.zh: 脚下的砖被我的重量压实。
lines.en: Tiles settle under my weight.
I follow the damp.

lines.zh: 我是一只花瓶，里面装的是海。
lines.en: I'm a vase. The sea is inside me.

lines.zh: 瓶口伸出几根枝，慢慢地动。
lines.en: Branches reach from my mouth. Slowly.
Cracks in my glaze. Blue.

lines.zh: 有人把我放在这里，我就站着。
lines.en: Someone set me here. So I stand.

lines.zh: 我肚子里的海水在低声响。
lines.en: Seawater murmurs inside me.

lines.zh: 我闻着空气，找潮的方向。
lines.en: I taste the air for the tide's direction.
My pattern is a white wave.

lines.zh: 这个房间太干，我不舒服。
lines.en: Too dry in this room. Uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 海嗣的东西，用来招待客人。
lines.en: Seaborn ware, made to receive guests.
I sway gently. Don't tip.
My glaze only shines when wet.
Listening. Waiting for you to come closer.

lines.zh: 瓶子是空的，里面是咸的。
lines.en: The vase is empty. It tastes of salt.
I've stood perfectly straight all along.
These branches are not decoration.

lines.zh: 从里面看外面，都是弯的。
lines.en: From inside, the world looks bent.

lines.zh: 我想起海，可这里没有海。
lines.en: I remember the sea. There's no sea here.
Quiet. I'm counting tides.

lines.zh: 你是来取水的，还是来看我的？
lines.en: Here for water, or for me?
My mouth turns to you. Manners.

lines.zh: 瓶口朝向陆地，我嗅到干土的味道。
lines.en: My mouth turns landward; I smell dry soil.

lines.zh: 我这样看着你，枝条不动。
lines.en: I watch you. The branches hold still.
Don't put your hand in my mouth.

lines.zh: 裂纹在你这一侧，看得清。
lines.en: The cracks face your side. You can see.
Shorter than I expected. Convenient.

lines.zh: 我体内在响，你听见了吗？
lines.en: Something's sounding inside me. Do you hear?
I've received many guests like this.
You stepped back. I'm still watching.

lines.zh: 青白色的釉，映出你的脸。
lines.en: My pale glaze shows your face.
No salt on you. Strange.
Another crack in me.
You knocked off a chip of glaze.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，水溅出来了。
lines.en: I wobbled. Water splashed out.
I can be mended. Slowly.
Porcelain feels pain. You doubt it.
My branches retracted.
Stop hitting the same place.

lines.zh: 身上的水少了，我变轻了。
lines.en: Less water inside. I feel lighter.
I retreat and lean against the wall.
This damage shows. Can't hide it.
Water? I have plenty inside.
What you're holding. I don't take it.
Only the tide interests me.
Put it down. Three steps back.

lines.zh: 那东西是干的，我不喜欢。
lines.en: That's dry. I don't care for it.

lines.zh: 我的瓶子不是用来盛那个的。
lines.en: My vase isn't for that.
Your palm smells too salty.
Don't hand it over. My mouth is narrow.
Pour that in and we're done being polite.

lines.zh: 花器里的海水，正等着你的体温。
lines.en: The seawater in my vase waits for your warmth.
Don't push. This porcelain cracks.
My body hit you. A sharp note.
I give half a step and steady.

lines.zh: 瓶身撞上你，瓷面裂开一道咸痕。
lines.en: My vase hits you and a salt line cracks across the glaze.
Don't bump. I'm expensive to fix.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀顶到我的枝条。
lines.en: Your shoulder caught my branches.

lines.zh: 瓶子倾斜了一下，又正回去。
lines.en: I leaned and righted myself.
A layer of glaze between us.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪，砖上留了印。
lines.en: I shift aside. A mark stays on the tile.

lines.zh: 你再撞一次，我就要还手。
lines.en: Bump again and I answer.
I'm a vessel, not a creature.
You want to look inside? No.

lines.zh: 另一个瓶子？这里只有一个。
lines.en: Another vase? There's only one.
My neck is porcelain. Don't press it.

lines.zh: 你这是跟一件家具说话。
lines.en: You're talking to furniture.

lines.zh: 我体内装的东西，不该给你看。
lines.en: What's inside me isn't for you.
Back away. Leave the branches.
Only the tide gets a reply from me.

lines.zh: 你把花插进来，我会生气。
lines.en: Put flowers in me and I'll be angry.
Such a request gets no answer.
Branches curl around it and lift.
Drop it in and it would sink.
I raise it and look through the glaze.
Water marks on the ground. I know them.

lines.zh: 这个我不放进去，太大了。
lines.en: Not this. Too big for my mouth.
The branches are thin. A weak grip.
I balance it on my rim.
Whose? Not returning it.
Smells like shore stone.
I'll keep it until the tide.
You touched what you shouldn't.
My branch tips turn toward you.
The water inside begins to swirl.
Your position is logged.
You've disturbed the arrangement.

lines.zh: 客人不守规矩，就得处理。
lines.en: Rude guests get handled.
The waves inside me grew louder.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，釉上有你的影子。
lines.en: You've backed to the wall. Your shadow is on my glaze.
This time I move first.

lines.zh: 海嗣的触须在瓶里绷紧了。
lines.en: The seaborn tendrils inside my vase pull taut.
The branches extend, one by one.

lines.zh: 我瓶身转了个角度，正对你。
lines.en: I turn my body to face you square.
You step back. I turn a little.
The water inside is rising.
Standing here, I'm the door.

lines.zh: 你绕左边，那边的枝更长。
lines.en: Go left. The branches are longer there.
My glaze looks white in your eyes.
I've counted every tile here.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，挡不住水。
lines.en: What you hold won't stop water.
No hurry. Porcelain is patient.
My mouth tips. Water flies out.
The branches whip out.
The porcelain rim strikes. Hard.
I lean my whole body onto you.

lines.zh: 你被水浇了一身，站不稳。
lines.en: Drenched, and you can't stand steady.
The branches wrap your wrist.

lines.zh: 这一下，我身上的裂纹又多一条。
lines.en: Now there's another crack in me.
There's something in the water. Worse than water.
You retreat. The floor is soaked.
Don't wipe your face. That water bites.
They carried me here and set me down.

lines.zh: 一只花瓶立在门边，里面是海。
lines.en: A vase by the door. The sea is inside.

lines.zh: 海嗣造的东西，开始动了。
lines.en: Seaborn craft, and it has started to move.
My glaze is still damp.
I landed and water seeped from the tiles.
Branches reach out of my mouth.
The tide will come. I'll stand and wait.
This spot faces the guests nicely.

lines.zh: 我出现的时候没有人听见。
lines.en: No one heard me arrive.
I'm furniture, and I'm a weapon.

lines.zh: 瓶子里传出很低的浪声。
lines.en: A low surf sound from inside me.
My glaze shows green in the dark.
The glaze burned black and split wider.

lines.zh: 摔到地上，边角碎了一块。
lines.en: Hit the ground. A corner of me shattered.

lines.zh: 我本来就是装水的，可这个太深。
lines.en: I hold water. This is too deep even for me.

lines.zh: 炸得我身子上多了个洞。
lines.en: The blast punched a hole through me.

lines.zh: 有个东西卡在我裂纹里。
lines.en: Something's lodged in a crack.
That power slid in through the glaze.

lines.zh: 体内的水干了，枝开始枯。
lines.en: Water's drying up. The branches wither.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，瓷身上全是电弧。
lines.en: Lightning. Arcs skittered over my body.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，瓷在路上就碎了。
lines.en: Falling, and the porcelain broke on the way.
